post.caption:
Human hearing is most sensitive roughly between 2,000 and 5,000 Hz, partly because the ear canal is a tube that resonates in exactly that range, so those frequencies arrive at the eardrum pre-amplified. That band is also where a baby's cry and a human scream sit, which is very likely not a coincidence. And it is why alarms, sirens and ringtones are deliberately engineered into it. They are not annoying by accident.
